executable.help:
Guffin - native GGUF chat on Metal

Usage: guffin -m MODEL [options]
       guffin inspect MODEL

Chat is the default. Give a prompt for one answer and exit.
Chat shows prompt/generation rates and internal TTFT after each reply.

  -m, --model FILE          Model GGUF (or use positional MODEL)
  -p, --prompt TEXT         Answer TEXT once, then exit
  -n, --max-new-tokens N    Optional reply token limit
  -c, --context-size N      Context capacity in tokens
      --draft-model FILE    Enable lossless speculative decoding
      --temperature T       Sampling temperature (default: 0.8)
      --greedy              Select the most likely token
      --seed N              Sampling seed (default: random)
      --stats               Also show timing for one-shot/piped output
  -h, --help                Show this help
      --help-all            Include advanced options
      --version             Show build identity

Examples:
  guffin -m models/gemma-3-12b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf
  guffin -m MODEL --draft-model DRAFT
  guffin -m MODEL -p "Explain unified memory" -n 128
